summary: Cue Biopharma filed an 8-K under Items 7.01, 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing positive topline Phase 2 results for CUE-221 in chronic spontaneous urticaria, with the trial run in China by Genesis Life Sciences, an Ascendant Health affiliate. The 145-patient, randomized, double-blind, placebo- and omalizumab-controlled study met its HSS7=0 primary endpoint at week 12 across all doses and its UAS7=0 secondary endpoint at 4 mg/kg. No deal, ownership, pricing or board-recommendation terms are present; this is a routine clinical-data disclosure, not a special situation.
